    Lemma 2.5 for mod A #

    The hypotheses of the abstract Lemma 2.5 (StrictLayers.strict) hold in mod A = FGModuleCat Aᵐᵒᵖ for a representation-finite algebra:

    • the right radical approximation of a module Y is the right mesh of Y: the biproduct of the minimal right almost split maps of the indecomposable summands of Y (with rad P → P at projective summands) and its kernel, a biproduct of left almost split maps (graded-category.tex);
    • the Krull–Schmidt split–radical normal form.

    Both are supplied by the vendored Auslander--Reiten library (moduleRightMesh, moduleRightTau, labelRightMesh_f_mono, exists_splitMono_radical_normalForm).
